notes_for_editor: The '?' in the Forest Lookouts name '(Crossett ?)' suggests the name is unsettled; NGS calls the station Fire Tower 1. The record's coordinates (33.0699, -91.9284) match NGS mark DK2075 (33 04 11 N, 091 55 42 W) within rounding. The Crossroads Fire Tower (us-ar-crossroads, about 33.23 N, -91.92) is roughly 18 km north of Crossett, while this survey point is 4.0 miles southeast of Crossett, so this is a different tower. The 125 ft figure is the 1939 description of the observing platform, not a current measurement; the 38.1 m height fact is that figure converted. No source gives a build year, present status or whether the tower survives; the editor could ask the Arkansas Forestry Commission. The record's agency field matches the Forest Lookouts listing.
